status.description: active: work is going on. done: it shipped. archived: kept, but no longer offered when tagging.

_note: A tag with a page. Anything in the space — a task, a doc, a design, a video, an experiment, a dashboard — is put in a project by an `in_project` edge from it to the project (projects.tag), so one project gathers every kind of work, and one item may be in several. Open to the whole workspace, like a label: a project names work, it does not hide it. What a reader may open inside it is still each item's own sharing.
